description: Third app-level set, authored 2026-11-19 and committed BEFORE the fixes for the five app_cases_v2 failures (two non-adjacent years, weekends vs weekdays, counting customers, share of orders, write requests) and before any run on it. No question repeats a v1 or v2 question; each v2 defect type gets two new questions in different wording (write requests get three), plus new breakdowns and declines. Same method as v1/v2 (evaluation/run_app_evaluation.py): full StructuredPlanningAgent with the app's current settings, answer table compared by VALUES with a hand-written reference DAX. Modes: rows = same rows in any order; top1 = first answer row matches first reference row. Unsupported cases pass when the app declines without running a query. Written by the developer who also wrote the rules and the fixes.

cases.question: Compare gross sales in 2022 and 2025
Orders in 2021 versus 2023
Units sold on weekdays and weekends
Weekend versus weekday gross profit in 2025
How many different customers shopped in 2024?
Number of customers by region
Card share of orders by year
Click & Collect share of orders by region
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimStore'[Region]), "Ch", "Click & Collect", "O", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('FactSales'[OrderID]), 'FactSales'[Channel] = "Click & Collect"), "S", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('FactSales'[OrderID]), 'FactSales'[Channel] = "Click & Collect"), DISTINCTCOUNT('FactSales'[OrderID])))

cases.question: Change the 2026 target for Jeddah Street 1 to 60000
Set net sales for Riyadh Mall 2 to zero
Increase all sales targets by 10%
Net sales by gender
Gross profit by age band in 2025
Which payment method brought in the most revenue in 2025?
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('FactSales'[PaymentMethod], TREATAS({2025}, 'DimDate'[Year]), "N", [Net Sales]) ORDER BY [N] DESC

cases.question: Margin % by store type
Units sold by subcategory this year
Cost by category in Q2 2025
Which brand grew the most between 2025 and 2026?
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimProduct'[Brand]), "A", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2025), "B", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026), "C", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026) - CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2025), "P", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026) - CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2025), CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2025))) ORDER BY [P] DESC
